```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("config/paths.R")
source("analysis/preprocessing/config.R")
preprocessing <- preprocessing_paths()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = preprocessing$root)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7
)
```

Extract male AML cells from GSE185381 into per-sample Seurat objects for cohort integration. Cell names use the `sample:barcode` identifiers in the reference metadata.

## Libraries and sample selection

```{r libraries}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(qs)
```

```{r metadata}
metadata <- read.csv(preprocessing$reference_metadata, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
required <- c("NAME", "sex", "disease__ontology_label")
stopifnot(all(required %in% names(metadata)))
metadata <- metadata %>%
  filter(sex == "male", disease__ontology_label == "acute myeloid leukemia")
sample_manifest <- read.csv(preprocessing$reference_samples, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (!"sample_id" %in% names(sample_manifest)) stop("Reference sample manifest requires sample_id.")
selected_samples <- as.character(sample_manifest$sample_id)
if (!length(selected_samples) || anyNA(selected_samples) ||
    any(!nzchar(selected_samples)) || anyDuplicated(selected_samples)) {
  stop("Reference sample_id values must be nonempty and unique.")
}
eligible_samples <- unique(vapply(strsplit(metadata$NAME, ":"), `[`, "", 1))
if (!all(selected_samples %in% eligible_samples)) {
  stop("Each reference sample must contain male AML cells in metadata.csv.")
}
```

## Export per-sample objects

```{r prepare_samples}
for (sample_name in selected_samples) {
  input_data <- Read10X(file.path(preprocessing$reference_counts, sample_name))
  rna_counts <- if (is.list(input_data)) input_data$`Gene Expression` else input_data
  object <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = rna_counts, project = sample_name)

  if (is.list(input_data) && "Antibody Capture" %in% names(input_data)) {
    object[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(
      counts = input_data$`Antibody Capture`[, colnames(object), drop = FALSE]
    )
  }

  object <- RenameCells(
    object, new.names = paste0(sample_name, ":", sub("-1$", "", colnames(object)))
  )
  object <- subset(object, cells = intersect(colnames(object), metadata$NAME))
  qsave(object, file.path(preprocessing$reference_objects, paste0(sample_name, ".qs")))
}
```

sessionInfo()
